My Trip to Japan

Last spring, I finally took the trip to Japan that I had been planning for years. The cherry blossoms were in full bloom when I arrived in Kyoto, and the sight was absolutely breathtaking. I spent my first three days exploring ancient temples and wandering through the narrow streets of the Higashiyama district.

On the fourth day, I took a bullet train to Tokyo. The contrast between Kyoto's traditional atmosphere and Tokyo's neon-lit energy was striking. I visited Shibuya Crossing, ate fresh sushi at Tsukiji Outer Market, and climbed to the top of the Tokyo Skytree for a panoramic view of the city.

One of my favorite experiences was staying at a traditional ryokan in Hakone. The hot springs, kaiseki dinner, and view of Mount Fuji made it unforgettable. I cannot recommend this experience enough to anyone visiting Japan.
